snapshot.text: Universal state health insurance (Aasandha) pays for care at home and abroad, mainly in India and Sri Lanka. In October 2026 the president reformed Aasandha, ending full coverage for people earning above MVR 60,000 a month.

priorities.title: Aasandha reform
priorities.text: Full coverage ends for people earning above MVR 60,000.

priorities.title: Cancer medicines
priorities.text: The government prioritises access to high-cost cancer medicines through Aasandha.
